questions.answer: the international office and student services where great and very helpfull

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: the master courses where nice, but very very very very time consuming, the amount of work does not reflect the amount of ECTS points, and there is just a lot of hand ins. The BA course was really nice, but

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: it was worse, in my eyes, they try to cover soooooo much stuff and then does not dig deep into anything, they just brush over stuff.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Classical field theory (BA course)
Advanced quantum field theory (MA)
Modelling and Simulations 
Field theory in condensed matter

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Classical field theory was good. Field theory in condensed matter was also pretty good, but they really try and cover a lot of stuff.
Modelling and Simulations was a horrible course! Dont take it
